Iron ore is a mineral block found underground. When mined with a stone pickaxe or better it drops raw iron, which is smelted into iron ingots.[1]

Deepslate iron ore is the variant found in deepslate layers, below Y=0.

Obtaining

[edit]

Breaking

edit

Iron ore requires a stone pickaxe or better to be mined. Mining it with a wooden or gold pickaxe, or by hand, destroys it and drops nothing.

BlockHandWoodenStoneIronDiamond
Iron Ore157.51.150.750.6
Deepslate Iron Ore22.511.251.71.150.85

With Fortune, more raw iron may drop. With Silk Touch the ore block itself drops.

Natural generation

edit

Iron ore generates in three batches. It is most common around level 16 and generates from level -24 to 56 in all overworld biomes. It is also common in mountains above level 80, where an upper batch generates up to level 384. Small veins generate evenly from level -64 to 72.

Iron ore below level 0 generates as deepslate iron ore. Large ore veins of iron mixed with raw iron blocks and tuff generate between Y=-60 and Y=-8.

Iron ore is also found in the chests of shipwrecks and buried treasure as iron ingots.
